body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.94 (naive sector base rate 0.88) that: Watts Water FY2026 adjusted operating margin (company-reported) is >=20.3%. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/US_INDUSTRIALS_peer_comparison.md section 5 = AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5, unchanged): p0 = 0.88 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', n=9); SAC +15.3 pts x weight 0.375 (N=12) -> p = 0.94. Evidence: Q3-2026 call: FY2026 adjusted operating margin 20.3-20.4% (+70 to +80 bp; Aug guide 19.8-20.4%). FY2025 19.6%. Q1-Q3 2026 20.1% / 21.0% / 20.9%. Resolution: YES if the FY2026 adjusted operating margin in Watts's Q4-2026 results release (8-K Item 2.02, Ex 99.1) is >= 20.3%, to one decimal. GAAP operating margin is NOT used. Source: Watts Q4-2026 8-K Ex 99.1 press release (SEC EDGAR). Resolve by 2027-03-15; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 3 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'margin' promises among the other US industrials peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=9). No company-specific information.

body: Market appears to price an inland up-cycle plus a data-center power-gen growth story at 17x forward EPS / 9.5x EV/EBITDA. Our view: no claimable mispricing; on reported FCF the price is roughly fair (~3.8% perpetual growth at 9.5% CoE), on NOPAT with honest reinvestment it is rich. Evidence: ROTC 10.4% (2023-25), escalators decelerating, term renewals flat-to-low-single-digit 2025-26, fuel lag, Jones Act waiver, receivables build, insider selling. Proves us wrong: FY26 EPS >= 7.28, 2027 renewals high-single digits, power-gen growth > 20%. Scored by thesis:paper-call:US-KEX:*.
